create_rl_environment: create a dm_control composer Environment with a custom task and time limit for RL training
reset_environment_episode: reset the composer Environment to start a new episode and get the initial timestep observation
step_environment_action: step the composer Environment with an action and receive the reward, discount, and observation
add_extra_hook: add a custom extra hook callable to the Environment for before_step or after_step lifecycle events
get_observation_spec: get the observation specification from the composer Environment to inspect observation shapes and dtypes
